$comment: Curated marketplace index. Every entry is reviewed and pinned to a commit; the extension installs from these only, unless developer mode is on. To list a kit, open a pull request adding an entry here; the maintainer reviews the kit's code before merging.

kits.name: linkedin
kits.description: Invitations and inbox triage on your own LinkedIn session: accept, ignore, connect, remove. Never sends a message.

kits.name: reddit
kits.description: Read Reddit from your own logged-in session: list, search, read threads. Read-only.
